why_2016_2019_was_originally_chosen.question: Why did the original primary design restrict cohorts to G in {2016, 2017, 2018, 2019} instead of estimating every cohort since 2004?

structural_reasons.description: In mineduc_directorio parquet files from 2004 to 2014, the column ESTADO_ESTAB does not exist. ESTADO_ESTAB (1=activo, 2=receso, 3=cerrado, 4=autorizado sin matrícula) was introduced in 2015.parquet. Therefore, G=2016 (transition from G-1=2015 to G=2016) was the first cohort where contemporaneous transition to ESTADO_ESTAB=3 was directly observed.
structural_reasons.resolution_for_full_series_2005_2024: Because 2015.parquet retains historical closed establishments with ESTADO_ESTAB=3 (2,978 closed RBDs recorded in 2015), combining longitudinal enrollment cessation in foundation.core.enrollment_2004_2025 (positive enrollment in G-1 and zero enrollment across [G, 2025]) with ESTADO_ESTAB=3 confirmation in 2015/2025 and RCID v1 student-flow depuration reconstructs the entire 2005-2024 cohort series without contemporaneous schema loss.

structural_reasons.description: Requiring 3 two-year non-enrollment placebos back to G-9 in a 2004-2025 panel forced G-9 >= 2004 (G >= 2013).
structural_reasons.resolution_for_full_series_2005_2024: Estimating cohort-specific ATT(g) for every G in 2005..2024 and reporting available pre-treatment leads per regime separates identification of ATT(g) from long-horizon pre-trend availability.

structural_reasons.description: Cohorts 2020-2022 experienced COVID-19 school closures, attendance measurement changes, and automatic promotion guidelines.
structural_reasons.resolution_for_full_series_2005_2024: Included explicitly in the 2005-2024 series as the '2020-2022 (Pandemia)' regime and separated from non-pandemic aggregates.

structural_reasons.description: Persistent two-year non-enrollment requires observing G and G+1 (making 2024 right-censored for that outcome, and 2025 right-censored for all post-closure outcomes).
structural_reasons.resolution_for_full_series_2005_2024: Cohort 2023 is estimated for all 4 outcomes; cohort 2024 is estimated for grade progression, attendance, and GPA (and marked right-censored only for 2-year persistent non-enrollment).

rcid_v1_specification.rule_title: Regla de Cierre Escolar Inferido desde los Datos (RCID v1)
rcid_v1_specification.epistemic_boundary: Strict separation between (a) documentary/legal certainty (Resoluciones Exentas / actas of official recognition revocation or merger, which are not observed in longitudinal microdata) and (b) empirical data-inferred closure (RCID v1 = D2), which identifies effective destruction of local school supply after purging directory continuity and concentrated student-flow absorption.

nested_hierarchy.D0_raw_closure: Active with positive enrollment in G-1 and zero enrollment / ESTADO_ESTAB=3 from G onward (no reopening in [G, 2025]).
nested_hierarchy.D1_strict_directory_exit: D0 minus directory continuity (annexes with active main school, early-childhood administrative consolidations, and registered RBD replacements).
nested_hierarchy.D2_rcid_v1_flow_depurated: D1 minus concentrated longitudinal student-flow absorption (baseline_students >= 10, assigned_students >= 10, top_destination_share >= 0.70, destination_HHI >= 0.50, and stable top destination in G and G+1).

post1_historical_1992_2012.note: Pre-longitudinal aggregate directory panel (1992-2012); motivates why Post III requires longitudinal student-flow depuration (RCID v1) from 2004 onward.

missingness_bounds_progression.method: arm-adversarial Manski-style bounds for unknown grade progression
